Job Description
BSRB Job Circular 2026:
বাংলাদেশ জাহাজ পুনঃপ্রক্রিয়াজাতকরণ বোর্ড তাদের শূন্য পদসমূহের জন্য জনবল নিয়োগের বিজ্ঞপ্তি প্রকাশ করেছে। বাংলাদেশ জাহাজ পুনঃপ্রক্রিয়াজাতকরণ বোর্ড ০৫ টি পদে মোট ০৭ জনকে নিয়োগ দেবে। উক্ত পদ গুলোতে নারী-পুরুষ উভয়ই আবেদন করতে পারবেন। আগ্রহী প্রার্থীরা অনলাইনে আবেদন করতে পারবেন। সম্পূর্ণ বিজ্ঞপ্তি বিস্তারিত দেওয়া হল।

MRA Job Circular 202
6: মাইক্রোক্রেডিট রেগুলেটরী অথরিটি (এমআরএ) এর শূন্য পদসমূহে জনবল নিয়োগ দেয়া হবে। মাইক্রোক্রেডিট রেগুলেটরী অথরিটি ০৭ টি পদে মোট ১২ জনকে নিয়োগ দেবে। পদগুলোতে নারী ও পুরুষ উভয়েই আবেদন করতে পারবেন। আগ্রহী প্রার্থীরা অনলাইনে আবেদন করতে পারবেন। সম্পূর্ণ বিজ্ঞপ্তি (MRA Job Circular 2026) বিস্তারিত দেওয়া হল। সরকারি বেসরকারি সকল চাকরির খবর সবার আগে পড়তে আমাদের সরকারি চাকরির খবর পেজে ভিজিট করুন।

Job Description
DLS Job Circular 2026:
মৎস ও প্রাণিসম্পদ মন্ত্রণালয়ের আওতাধীন প্রাণিসম্পদ অধিদপ্তর এর শূন্য পদসমূহে জনবল নিয়োগের বিজ্ঞপ্তি প্রকাশ করেছে। প্রাণিসম্পদ অধিদপ্তর ০২ টি পদে মোট ৫৩৮ জনকে নিয়োগ দেবে। আগ্রহী প্রার্থীরা অনলাইনে আবেদন করতে পারবেন। নারী-পুরুষ উভয়ই আবেদন করতে পারবেন। আগ্রহ ও যোগ্যতা থাকলে আপনিও আবেদন করতে পারেন। সম্পূর্ণ চাকরির খবর বিস্তারিত দেওয়া হল।

পুলিশ সুপার কার্যালয়ে নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি Police Super Office Job Circular 2026
Job Description
Police Super Office Job Circular 2026:
বাংলাদেশের রাঙ্গামাটি পার্বত্য জেলা পুলিশ সুপার কার্যালয়ে নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি প্রকাশ হয়েছে। রাঙ্গামাটি পার্বত্য জেলা পুলিশ সুপার কার্যালয়ে শূন্য পদসমূহে লোক নিয়োগ দেওয়া হচ্ছে। রাঙ্গামাটি পার্বত্য জেলা পুলিশ সুপার কার্যালয়ে ০২ টি পদে মোট ০৫ জনকে নিয়োগ দেবে। শুধুমাত্র রাঙ্গামাটি পার্বত্য জেলার স্থায়ী বাসিন্দাদের দরখাস্ত করার আহ্বান করা হচ্ছে। আগ্রহ ও যোগ্যতা থাকলে আপনিও আবেদন করতে পারেন। আবেদন প্রক্রিয়াসহ সম্পূর্ণ বিজ্ঞপ্তি বিস্তারিত দেওয়া হল।

পদ সংখ্যা: ০৪ টি।
শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা: উচ্চ মাধ্যমিক বা সমমানের পরীক্ষায় উত্তীর্ণ।
অন্যান্য যোগ্যতা: কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারের ক্ষেত্রে Word Processing/Data Entry/Typing-এর সর্বনিম্ন গতি প্রতি মিনিটে বাংলায় ২০ শব্দ ও ইংরেজিতে ২০ শব্দ থাকতে হবে। কম্পিউটারের Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint এ কাজ করার দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
বেতন স্কেল: ৯,৩০০–২২,৪৯০/- টাকা।

সময়
: আবেদন প্রক্রিয়া শুরু হয়েছে।
আবেদনের শেষ সময:
০১ অক্টোবর ২০২৬ তারিখ বিকাল ০৪:০০ টায় শেষ হবে।
আবেদন
প্রক্রিয়া:
আগ্রহী প্রার্থীদের পুলিশ সুপার, রাঙ্গামাটি পুলিশ সুপার কার্যালয় বরাবরে আবেদনপত্র আগামী ০১/১০/২০২৬খ্রিঃ (অফিস চলাকালীন সময়) তারিখের মধ্যে অবশ্যই ডাকযোগে পৌঁছাতে হবে। হাতে হাতে কিংবা সরাসরি কোন আবেদনপত্র গৃহীত হবে না। নির্ধারিত তারিখের পরে প্রাপ্ত যে কোন আবেদন বাতিল বলে গণ্য হবে।।

Job Description
বিভাগীয় কমিশনারের কার্যালয়, ময়মনসিংহ এর শূন্য পদসমূহে জনবল নিয়োগের জন্য চাকরির বিজ্ঞপ্তি প্রকাশ হয়েছে। ময়মনসিংহ বিভাগীয় কমিশনারের কার্যালয় ০২ টি পদে মোট ০৯ জনকে নিয়োগ দেবে। আগ্রহী প্রার্থীরা অনলাইনে আবেদন করতে পারবেন। উক্ত পদসমূহে নারী-পুরুষ উভয়ই আবেদন করতে পারবেন। আবেদন প্রক্রিয়াসহ সম্পূর্ণ চাকরির খবর বিস্তারিত দেওয়া হল।

অন্যান্য যোগ্যতা : সাঁটলিপিতে প্রতি মিনিটে শব্দের গতি বাংলা ও ইংরেজিতে যথাক্রমে ৫০ ও ৮০, ওয়ার্ড প্রসেসিং, ডাটা এন্ট্রি এবং টাইপিং-এ প্রতি মিনিটে শব্দের গতি বাংলা ও ইংরেজিতে যথাক্রমে ২৫ ও ৩০।

Tax Zone-16 Dhaka Job Circular 2026:
কর কমিশনারের কার্যালয়, কর অঞ্চল-১৬, ঢাকা এর অধীনে ০৬ টি পদে মোট ৩৯ জনকে নিয়োগ দেবে। পদগুলোতে নারী ও পুরুষ উভয়েই আবেদন করতে পারবেন। আগ্রহী প্রার্থীরা অনলাইনে আবেদন করতে পারবেন। এই চাকরিতে ঢাকা বিভাগের সকল জেলা প্রার্থীরা আবেদন করতে পারবেন। সম্পূর্ণ বিজ্ঞপ্তি বিস্তারিত দেওয়া হল।

Job Purpose
To design intuitive, customer-centric user interfaces and experiences for the Bank's digital banking products, ensuring designs align with brand guidelines, usability best practices, and evolving customer needs.
Functional Responsibilities
UI/UX Design & Product Experience:
Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs for digital banking products, websites, and mobile applications. Support the end-to-end design process from concept through final handoff for development.
User Research & Experience Insights:
Conduct user research, usability testing, and customer journey mapping to inform design decisions and improve customer experience. Test and iterate on designs based on user feedback, analytics, usability findings, and A/B testing results.
Design Governance & Consistency:
Ensure design consistency and adherence to the Bank’s guidelines, accessibility standards, and approved design system. Create and maintain design assets, style guides, component libraries, and reusable UI patterns for digital products.
Continuous Improvement & Innovation:
Stay updated on UI/UX design trends, tools, technologies, and best practices within digital banking and fintech. Recommend design improvements and innovative user experience solutions to enhance product usability, engagement, and digital adoption.

Title:
Transaction Service, Retail Distribution, Retail Banking
Company Name:
A Private Commercial Bank
Vacancy:

Job Location:
Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary:

Experience:
At most 2 years
Published:
2026-09-15
Application Deadline:
2026-09-21
Education:
Bachelor/Honors
Requirements:
At most 2 years
Skills Required:
Additional Requirements:
Age 25 to 32 years
Responsibilities & Context:
Execution of Transaction:
Cash receive from customer and payment to customer with proper checking and counting of physical cash through manual and machine support (counting machine). Posting of all transactions in core banking software as per delegation. Execute Islami Banking transactions (receipt/payment) through IB software (Ababil) and core software. Receiving clearing & collection cheques and maintaining clearing/collection cheque inward/outward register. Process clearing cheque through related software (MICR & BACH). Act as clearing house representative of branch. Physically present at clearing house for local clearing at Sonali Bank for rural branches. Remittance to local Feeding bank (Sonali bank as representative of Bangladesh Bank) and other bank branches maintaining process guidelines. Assistance to chief teller in collection, Selling & purchasing of prize bond and preservation of stamps for internal use. FCY currency transaction. Collection of utility bills (PDB/WASA etc). Collection of various fees of BRTA through separate BRTA software and reporting including posting at core software at day end. Maintenance and exchange of coins and mutilated notes at cash counters. Sorting of cash manually as per process for onward payment and remittance to feeding branch/Bangladesh bank. Active support to chief teller for cash management at branch ATM & CDM. Support to various offsite collection (ie; CR Booth at Airport) booths. Cash/Prize Bond/Stamp collection and delivery to various branches as per their requisition/requirement by the Feeding branches. Act as Chief of Transaction Service in case of leave of Chief of Transaction Service.
Ensure Customer Service:
Ensuring responses to customer queries at cash counter regarding their accounts. Ensuring fasts possible transaction with accuracy to maintain appropriate queue management (EQM). Ensure SLA is maintained for each and every transaction services provided to customer. Ensure faster service to large customers of Corporate and Commercial and SME division. Ensure service to collection accounts (GP/Bkash/Alico etc) of Cash Management through related separate software.
Ensuring Compliance & Regulatory Requirements:
Check all instruments for validity and acceptability and decline transaction that involves false or confusing information. Checking and confirmation of all cheque placed in the counter through various related software (MICR) and phone calls before payment. Inform any suspicious transaction to the upper management of the branch immediately. Inform customer and CS team for TP update requirement of the customers. Completing proper KYC at counter for walk-in customers transactions needs. Cross checking of daily cash transactions and delivery of daily vouchers to CSM for final tally for submission to branch operation member. Daily reconciliation of all transactions. Ensure smooth service for External, Internal & Statutory Audit Inspection time to count physical cash.
Promote, Educate and Advise Customers on Products & Services of the Bank:
Keep updated regularly regarding features/requirements/charges of the products and services of the bank. Keep all relevant forms, brochures and information to educate customers for promoting bank’s product and services. Assist customer to complete any application.
Achievement of Business Targets and Revenue Generation:
Maintaining Acquisition of new business through effective customer communication and relationship and meet business targets as per given KPI. Preparation of loan and credit card applications and follow up with approval with related department (Credit & Collection). Cross selling all the bank's products. Realization of  online charges & fees as per SOC. Proper usage and control of stationary and equipment to control the cost of the branch.

Assistance to chief teller in collection, Selling & purchasing of prize bond and preservation of stamps for internal use. FCY currency transaction. Collection of utility bills (PDB/WASA etc). Collection of various fees of BRTA through separate BRTA software and reporting including posting at core software at day end. Maintenance and exchange of coins and mutilated notes at cash counters. Sorting of cash manually as per process for onward payment and remittance to feeding branch/Bangladesh bank. Active support to chief teller for cash management at branch ATM & CDM. Support to various offsite collection (ie; CR Booth at Airport) booths. Cash/Prize Bond/Stamp collection and delivery to various branches as per their requisition/requirement by the Feeding branches. Act as Chief of Transaction Service in case of leave of Chief of Transaction Service.
Ensure Customer Service: Ensuring responses to customer queries at cash counter regarding their accounts. Ensuring fasts possible transaction with accuracy to maintain appropriate queue management (EQM). Ensure SLA is maintained for each and every transaction services provided to customer. Ensure faster service to large customers of Corporate and Commercial and SME division. Ensure service to collection accounts (GP/Bkash/Alico etc) of Cash Management through related separate software.
Ensuring Compliance & Regulatory Requirements: Check all instruments for validity and acceptability and decline transaction that involves false or confusing information. Checking and confirmation of all cheque placed in the counter through various related software (MICR) and phone calls before payment. Inform any suspicious transaction to the upper management of the branch immediately. Inform customer and CS team for TP update requirement of the customers. Completing proper KYC at counter for walk-in customers transactions needs. Cross checking of daily cash transactions and delivery of daily vouchers to CSM for final tally for submission to branch operation member. Daily reconciliation of all transactions. Ensure smooth service for External, Internal & Statutory Audit Inspection time to count physical cash.
Promote, Educate and Advise Customers on Products & Services of the Bank: Keep updated regularly regarding features/requirements/charges of the products and services of the bank. Keep all relevant forms, brochures and information to educate customers for promoting bank’s product and services. Assist customer to complete any application.
Achievement of Business Targets and Revenue Generation: Maintaining Acquisition of new business through effective customer communication and relationship and meet business targets as per given KPI. Preparation of loan and credit card applications and follow up with approval with related department (Credit & Collection). Cross selling all the bank's products. Realization of online charges & fees as per SOC. Proper usage and control of stationary and equipment to control the cost of the branch.

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Human Resource Management, Management, Business Administration or a relevant discipline.
Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Factory/Industrial HR, handling thousands of workforce, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of manpower planning, recruitment, attendance, leave and HR operations.
Hands-on experience of HRIS Software will get high preference.
Practical experience in worker and staff recruitment and onboarding.
Good understanding of employee relations, grievance handling and disciplinary procedures.
Working knowledge of Bangladesh Labour Law and factory HR compliance requirements.
Experience in payroll inputs, overtime, attendance and HR cost-related activities.
Ability to prepare and analyze HR reports, headcount, turnover, absenteeism and manpower data.
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word.
Good communication, interpersonal, problem-solving and negotiation skills.
Ability to work effectively with Production, Admin, Accounts, Safety and other factory functions.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple HR activities within deadlines.
Responsibilities & Context:
Manage overall HR operations and ensure smooth day-to-day HR activities.
Prepare manpower plans and requisitions based on production and departmental requirements.
Manage recruitment and selection of workers, operators, staff and officers.
Coordinate employee joining, onboarding, documentation and HRIS updates.
Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, leave, overtime and manpower deployment.
Maintain employee personal files, HR records and other required documentation.
Handle employee grievances, workplace issues, counselling and employee relations matters.
Coordinate disciplinary actions and ensure proper documentation in line with company policy.
Coordinate employee confirmation, transfer, promotion, increment and other HR movements.
Provide accurate attendance, leave and overtime data for payroll and salary processing.
Monitor employee turnover, manpower shortage and replacement requirements and take necessary actions.
Coordinate performance appraisal, employee development and training activities.
Ensure implementation of HR policies, procedures and applicable labour-law requirements.
Prepare regular HR reports and analyze headcount, absenteeism, turnover, overtime and manpower cost.
Coordinate with Head Office HR, Production, Admin, Accounts, Safety and other departments to resolve HR-related issues.

T/A,Mobile bill,Tour allowance

Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2

Life Insurance coverage
Excellent career growth as per performance

Age At least 24 years

Job Summary
We are looking for a confident and results-driven Marketing & Customer Success Executive with previous call center, telesales, customer service, or lead generation experience.
The candidate will communicate with US-based prospects and customers, generate leads, conduct follow-ups and product demos, support customer onboarding, and maintain strong client relationships.
Key Responsibilities
* Handle inbound and outbound calls with US prospects and customers
* Generate leads through calls, email, LinkedIn, and social media
* Conduct follow-ups, meetings, and product/service demonstrations
* Convert qualified prospects into customers
* Support customer onboarding and handle customer queries
* Maintain leads and customer information in CRM systems
* Support marketing and outreach campaigns
* Track leads, meetings, conversions, and customer activities
Requirements
* Previous call center, telesales, customer service, or lead generation experience
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong communication, sales, negotiation, and follow-up skills
* Confident communicating with American customers
* Comfortable with cold calling and working during US business hours
* Basic knowledge of digital marketing and CRM tools
* Reliable internet connection for remote work
Preferred Experience
Experience with US call center campaigns, B2B/SaaS sales, technology products, HubSpot/Salesforce/Zoho, LinkedIn prospecting, or email marketing will be an advantage.
Benefits
* Competitive base salary
* Performance-based commission/incentives
* Opportunity to work with international clients
* Career growth based on performance
Candidates with US call center experience are strongly encouraged to apply.

বিদেশে জনশক্তি নিয়োগ ও ম্যানপাওয়ার সেবার জন্য মার্কেটিং কৌশল তৈরি ও বাস্তবায়ন করা।
নতুন ব্যবসায়িক সুযোগ ও সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্ট খুঁজে বের করা এবং ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি করা।
বিদ্যমান ক্লায়েন্ট, ব্যবসায়িক অংশীদার ও সংশ্লিষ্ট ব্যক্তিদের সঙ্গে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
বিদেশি নিয়োগকর্তা ও রিক্রুটমেন্ট পার্টনারদের সঙ্গে জনশক্তির চাহিদা নিয়ে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও সমন্বয় করা।
রিক্রুটমেন্ট সেবা ও চাকরির সুযোগ সম্ভাব্য প্রার্থী ও ক্লায়েন্টদের কাছে প্রচার করা।
ক্লায়েন্ট ও সম্ভাব্য ব্যবসায়িক লিডের সঙ্গে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা।
প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্ট, প্রতিষ্ঠান ও সংশ্লিষ্ট সংস্থায় সরাসরি মার্কেটিং ভিজিট করা।
মার্কেটিং রিপোর্ট, ক্লায়েন্ট আপডেট এবং ফলোআপ সংক্রান্ত তথ্য সংরক্ষণ ও প্রস্তুত করা।
জনশক্তি নিয়োগের প্রয়োজনীয়তা অনুযায়ী রিক্রুটমেন্ট ও অপারেশন টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা।
ক্লায়েন্টের বিভিন্ন প্রশ্নের পেশাদারভাবে উত্তর দেওয়া এবং রিক্রুটমেন্ট সেবা সম্পর্কে সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান করা।
বিদেশে জনশক্তি নিয়োগ খাতের বাজার পরিস্থিতি ও প্রতিযোগীদের কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মাসিক মার্কেটিং ও ব্যবসায়িক লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন করা।

Responsibilities & Context:
About AYAT Education:
AYAT Education is a purpose-driven social enterprise committed to enhancing the quality of life through human capital development. We bridge education, healthcare, skills development, caregiving, and safe skilled migration to create dignified employment opportunities and improve lives. Our ventures include AYAT College of Nursing & Health Sciences (ACNHS), AYAT Care, AYAT Care Training Institute (ACTI), AYAT Skill Development Center (ASDC), AYAT Network, AYAT Career Development Center (AYAT CDC), and public health and policy research initiatives. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a creative and performance-driven digital marketing professional to strengthen our digital presence, build our brand, and generate high-quality leads across our diverse ventures.
Position Overview:
AYAT Education is looking for a creative, strategic, and hands-on Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Visual Communications & Multimedia to lead the organization's visual storytelling and multimedia production. This role will be responsible for producing high-quality graphics, photography, videography, video editing, motion graphics, and digital content that strengthen AYAT Education's brand and communicate the impact of its education, healthcare, caregiving, skills development, and migration initiatives.
The ideal candidate is a visual storyteller who can transform programs, people, and impact into compelling multimedia content across digital platforms, publications, reports, campaigns, and events. The position requires both creative excellence and the ability to work closely with program teams, researchers, and communications professionals to document AYAT's work professionally.
Key Responsibilities:
Visual Storytelling and Multimedia Production
Lead the production of compelling visual stories showcasing AYAT Education's programs, beneficiaries, students, caregivers, faculty, partners, and community impact
Capture and produce high-quality photography and videography for organizational campaigns, field visits, training programs, events, workshops, and institutional activities
Develop documentary-style impact stories, testimonials, success stories, interviews, and promotional videos
Create multimedia content tailored for social media, websites, digital campaigns, presentations, and donor communications
Graphic Design and Brand Identity
Design creative marketing and communication materials aligned with AYAT Education's brand guidelines
Produce brochures, leaflets, flyers, banners, posters, roll-up stands, certificates, presentation templates, social media creatives, infographics, and digital advertisements
Maintain visual consistency across all AYAT Education ventures and communication platforms
Support branding initiatives for AYAT Care, ACNHS, ACTI, ASDC, AYAT Network, and research projects
Video Editing, Animation, and Motion Graphics
Edit professional promotional videos, interviews, event highlights, educational videos, and campaign videos
Produce short-form videos optimized for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and other digital platforms
Develop animations, motion graphics, animated explainers, logo animations, and infographic videos for campaigns and presentations
Ensure videos are optimized for different digital platforms and audience engagement
Publications, Reports, and Creative Design
Lead the visual design and layout of annual reports, donor reports, research publications, white papers, newsletters, policy briefs, and institutional documents
Design publications that meet professional standards for development partners, donors, and corporate stakeholders
Coordinate with the Research & Knowledge Management team to create visually engaging knowledge products and publications
Digital Content and Campaign Support
Collaborate with the Communications Manager and Digital Marketing team to produce creative assets for marketing campaigns and admissions promotions
Develop visual content for student recruitment, caregiver recruitment, skilled migration campaigns, fundraising initiatives, and public awareness campaigns
Support live campaign coverage through photography, videography, and real-time content creation during events and field activities
Website and Digital Experience Support
Prepare visual assets for AYAT Education's websites and landing pages
Coordinate with website developers to ensure visual consistency across websites
Support website redesign, user interface improvements, and digital asset management
Contribute ideas to improve user experience (UI/UX) and visual engagement across digital platforms
Creative Asset Management and Innovation
Maintain AYAT Education's digital media library, including photographs, videos, design templates, icons, brand assets, and project archives
Develop standard templates for presentations, reports, social media campaigns, and organizational communication materials
Stay updated on emerging trends in multimedia storytelling, AI-powered design tools, animation, photography, videography, and digital content production
Explore innovative formats and technologies to strengthen AYAT Education's digital presence and audience engagement
Job Other Benifits:
Opportunity to build one of Bangladesh's leading purpose-driven brands
Work on impactful campaigns across education, healthcare, caregiving, workforce development, and skilled migration
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Medical insurance and life insurance
Two festival bonuses and a performance-based yearly increment
Six months of paid maternity leave and 15 days of paid paternity leave
17 days of paid annual leave, 10 days of paid casual leave, and 14 days of paid sick leave
Work in a multicultural environment with diverse and talented people from Bangladesh and abroad

About AYAT Education:
AYAT Education is a purpose-driven social enterprise committed to enhancing the quality of life through human capital development. We bridge education, healthcare, skills development, caregiving, and safe skilled migration to create dignified employment opportunities and improve lives. Our ventures include AYAT College of Nursing & Health Sciences (ACNHS), AYAT Care, AYAT Care Training Institute (ACTI), AYAT Skill Development Center (ASDC), AYAT Network, AYAT Career Development Center (AYAT CDC), and public health and policy research initiatives. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a creative and performance-driven digital marketing professional to strengthen our digital presence, build our brand, and generate high-quality leads across our diverse ventures.
Position Overview:
AYAT Education is looking for a creative, strategic, and hands-on Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Visual Communications & Multimedia to lead the organization's visual storytelling and multimedia production. This role will be responsible for producing high-quality graphics, photography, videography, video editing, motion graphics, and digital content that strengthen AYAT Education's brand and communicate the impact of its education, healthcare, caregiving, skills development, and migration initiatives.
The ideal candidate is a visual storyteller who can transform programs, people, and impact into compelling multimedia content across digital platforms, publications, reports, campaigns, and events. The position requires both creative excellence and the ability to work closely with program teams, researchers, and communications professionals to document AYAT's work professionally.
Key Responsibilities:
Visual Storytelling and Multimedia Production
Lead the production of compelling visual stories showcasing AYAT Education's programs, beneficiaries, students, caregivers, faculty, partners, and community impact
Capture and produce high-quality photography and videography for organizational campaigns, field visits, training programs, events, workshops, and institutional activities
Develop documentary-style impact stories, testimonials, success stories, interviews, and promotional videos
Create multimedia content tailored for social media, websites, digital campaigns, presentations, and donor communications
Graphic Design and Brand Identity
Design creative marketing and communication materials aligned with AYAT Education's brand guidelines
Produce brochures, leaflets, flyers, banners, posters, roll-up stands, certificates, presentation templates, social media creatives, infographics, and digital advertisements
Maintain visual consistency across all AYAT Education ventures and communication platforms
Support branding initiatives for AYAT Care, ACNHS, ACTI, ASDC, AYAT Network, and research projects
Video Editing, Animation, and Motion Graphics
Edit professional promotional videos, interviews, event highlights, educational videos, and campaign videos
Produce short-form videos optimized for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and other digital platforms
Develop animations, motion graphics, animated explainers, logo animations, and infographic videos for campaigns and presentations
Ensure videos are optimized for different digital platforms and audience engagement
Publications, Reports, and Creative Design
Lead the visual design and layout of annual reports, donor reports, research publications, white papers, newsletters, policy briefs, and institutional documents
Design publications that meet professional standards for development partners, donors, and corporate stakeholders
Coordinate with the Research & Knowledge Management team to create visually engaging knowledge products and publications
Digital Content and Campaign Support
Collaborate with the Communications Manager and Digital Marketing team to produce creative assets for marketing campaigns and admissions promotions
Develop visual content for student recruitment, caregiver recruitment, skilled migration campaigns, fundraising initiatives, and public awareness campaigns
Support live campaign coverage through photography, videography, and real-time content creation during events and field activities
Website and Digital Experience Support
Prepare visual assets for AYAT Education's websites and landing pages

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work in a challenging and fast-paced humanitarian environment.
Cultural sensitivity and respect for affected populations.
Flexibility and willingness to support emergency operations.
Working Conditions
The position will be based at a Primary Health Care Centre (PHCC) in the Rohingya Response, Cox’s Bazar.
The role involves supporting both clinical and non-clinical operational requirements.
The position holder may be required to coordinate activities across different PHCC service areas and support facilities.
The role may involve regular coordination with programme, support, and field teams.
The position holder may be required to work outside regular working hours during emergencies or critical operational situations.
The role involves working in a challenging and fast-paced humanitarian healthcare environment.
Responsibilities & Context:
Duty Station:
Camp 5 & 12, Ukhiya, Cox’s Bazar
Reports to:
Deputy Project Coordinator
Accountable to:
Project Coordinator
Position Summary
The Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics will be responsible for supporting the efficient and effective management of administration, logistics, asset management, procurement, transport & facility opertaion, coordination with warehouse, general operational support and supportive to the clinical team for smooth operation of the Primary Health Care Centre (PHCC) in the Rohingya Response, Cox’s Bazar.
The position holder will ensure that administrative and logistical systems are implemented effectively to support uninterrupted healthcare service delivery. The role is to coordinate with clinical and support them to ensure the availability of all necessary resources, equipment, supplies, transportation etc.
The Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics will work closely with the PHCC/Clinical Coordinator, Medical Officer Lead, Medical Warehouse Officer, Pharmacy, Nursing, Midwifery, Laboratory, IPC, Surveillance, Finance, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Security, WASH, and other relevant programme and support teams.
KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:
Administrative Management & Operational Support
Provide administrative support to clinical and non-clinical teams.
Support the day-to-day administrative operations of the PHCC.
Ensure effective administrative systems and procedures are maintained.
Maintain proper documentation considering due diligence and audit.
Prepare letters, notices, meeting minutes, official correspondence, and other administrative documents as required.
Organize meetings, training, and workshops including refreshments and transport when and as necessary.
Ensure timely follow-up of administrative and operational action points.
Coordinate with all relevant departments and support functions.
PHCC Facility & Office Management
Support the day-to-day operation of PHCC considering the administrative arena.
Ensure cleanliness of the facility and its premises.
Support the maintenance of the patients’ queue in an organized manner.
Monitor the availability of electricity, water, lighting, ventilation, and other essential utilities.
Support the maintenance of a clean, safe, functional, and professional working environment.
Monitor the overall condition of offices, clinical support areas, waiting areas, and common facilities.
Manage maintenance and repairments.
Coordinate with relevant teams for timely maintenance and repair of facilities.
Ensure appropriate office arrangements and workspace availability for staff.
Monitor office furniture and general equipment.
Manage asset inventory.
Support facility readiness for routine service delivery and emergencies.
Coordinate with the ambulance driver and ensure effective utilization.
Logistics Coordination
Management of vendor to support the clinical and non clinical team.
Coordinate day-to-day logistical support for PHCC activities.
Ensure required logistical arrangements are available to support uninterrupted healthcare services.
Coordinate the movement and delivery of supplies, equipment, and materials.
Support timely distribution of approved operational and programme supplies.
Coordinate with Supply Chain and Procurement teams regarding logistical requirements.
Monitor pending logistical requests and follow up for timely action.
Support planning and coordination of logistics for PHCC activities, trainings, meetings, and emergency responses.
Identify logistical gaps that may affect service delivery and report them promptly.
Procurement Coordination
Develop annual procurement plan and execute the plan.
Support PHCC teams in preparing and submitting procurement requests according to organizational procedures and following the annual plan.
Review requests for completeness and appropriate supporting documentation.
Coordinate with Procurement and Supply Chain teams regarding approved requests.
Follow up on the status of procurement requests.
Ensure timely communication regarding expected delivery timelines.
Support receiving and verification of general supplies and equipment.
Maintain records of procurement requests and related documents.
Ensure procurement activities follow organizational policies and procedures.
Support proper planning of recurring operational requirements.
Asset & Equipment Management
Maintain accurate records of PHCC assets and equipment.
Ensure assets are properly tagged and recorded according to organizational procedures.
Support regular physical verification of assets.
Maintain updated asset registers and movement records.
Monitor the condition and location of assigned assets.
Report lost, damaged, or missing assets promptly.
Coordinate repair and maintenance of office and operational equipment.
Support asset handover and return processes.
Ensure proper storage and security of PHCC assets.
Support periodic asset inventories and audits.
Transport & Vehicle Coordination
Coordinate transport requirements for PHCC staff and programme activities.
Support vehicle scheduling and transport planning.
Coordinate staff movement and transportation according to operational requirements.
Support transportation arrangements for approved meetings, trainings, field visits, and programme activities.
Coordinate emergency transportation requirements when requested.
Maintain transport requests and related records.
Coordinate with drivers and transport focal points.
Monitor vehicle availability and communicate transport constraints promptly.
Support efficient and cost-effective use of organizational vehicles.
Supply & General Store Management
Support the management of general office and operational supplies.
Monitor stock levels of stationery, office supplies, cleaning materials, and other non-medical commodities.
Maintain appropriate stock records for assigned general supplies.
Ensure proper storage and organization of general supplies.
Support timely replenishment of essential non-medical items.
Conduct periodic physical stock counts and reconciliation.
Report shortages, damaged items, and stock discrepancies.
Coordinate with the Medical Warehouse Officer and Supply Chain team when relevant.
Facility Maintenance & Repair
Monitor maintenance requirements across the PHCC.
Identify and report facility maintenance needs promptly.
Coordinate repair and maintenance activities with relevant teams and service providers.
Follow up on maintenance requests until completion.
Maintain records of maintenance and repair activities.
Support preventive maintenance planning.
Ensure maintenance activities minimize disruption to healthcare services.
Immediately report urgent maintenance issues affecting patient safety or service delivery.
Utilities & Essential Services
Monitor the availability and functionality of essential utilities, including:
Electricity and backup power.
Water supply.
Lighting.
Ventilation.
Communication facilities.
Internet connectivity, where applicable.
Report interruptions or technical problems promptly.
Coordinate with relevant teams to restore essential services.
Support contingency planning for utility disruptions.
Maintain relevant records related to facility operational requirements.
Safety, Security & Access Support
Support implementation of organizational safety and security procedures within the PHCC.
Coordinate with Security personnel regarding operational and facility security concerns.
Support appropriate access control for non-public areas.
Monitor and report safety hazards.
Ensure emergency exits and access routes remain clear.
Support appropriate placement and availability of safety equipment.
Assist in maintaining visitor and access records where applicable.
Immediately report security incidents or concerns to the appropriate supervisor.
Support security arrangements during emergencies.
Coordination with Clinical & Support Teams
Work closely with the Clinical Coordinator and relevant clinical teams to understand operational requirements.
Coordinate with Pharmacy, Medical Warehouse, Laboratory, IPC, Surveillance, Nursing, and Midwifery teams regarding administrative and logistical needs.
Support timely provision of non-medical operational supplies.
Coordinate with HR, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Security, and other support functions.
Participate in relevant coordination meetings.
Communicate operational constraints and logistical challenges promptly.
Support coordinated solutions to operational issues affecting healthcare services.
Staff Attendance & Administrative Records
Support the maintenance of staff attendance and administrative records as required.
Coordinate collection and submission of attendance information according to organizational procedures.
Support leave and staff movement documentation when assigned.
Maintain updated staff contact and emergency contact lists as appropriate.
Support onboarding and administrative arrangements for new staff.
Assist in coordinating staff ID cards, workspace, equipment, and other required administrative support.
Maintain confidentiality of staff information.
Visitor & Meeting Management
Support management of official visitors to the PHCC.
Coordinate administrative arrangements for monitoring visits, donor visits, and official meetings.
Maintain visitor records when required.
Ensure appropriate logistical arrangements are available for visitors.
Coordinate meeting schedules and facilities.
Support preparation of meeting materials and documentation.
Ensure follow-up of agreed action points.
Emergency Preparedness & Operational Continuity
Support PHCC preparedness for operational emergencies.
Ensure essential administrative and logistical resources are available during emergencies.
Support contingency planning for disruptions to facilities, utilities, transportation, and supplies.
Assist in organizing logistics during disease outbreaks, fires, natural disasters, mass casualty incidents, or other humanitarian emergencies.
Support rapid mobilization of non-medical supplies and operational resources.
Coordinate emergency transportation and facility support as required.
Remain flexible to undertake additional responsibilities during emergency response.
Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance
Support implementation of organizational health and safety procedures.
Identify and report workplace hazards and unsafe conditions.
Support corrective actions to address identified safety risks.
Promote safe working practices among staff.
Support appropriate management of general waste and environmental cleanliness.
Coordinate with IPC and WASH teams regarding facility hygiene and environmental requirements.
Support fire safety and emergency preparedness measures.
Ensure relevant safety notices and emergency information are displayed where required.
Documentation & Record Management
Maintain accurate and organized administrative and logistics records.
Maintain records of:
Procurement requests and follow-up.
Asset registers.
Stock records.
Transport requests.
Maintenance requests.
Meeting records.
Visitor records.
Facility inspections.
Administrative correspondence.
Ensure documents are properly filed and easily accessible for authorized review.
Maintain electronic and physical records according to organizational procedures.
Ensure confidentiality and appropriate security of organizational information.
Reporting
Prepare and submit regular administrative and logistics reports.
Maintain updates on key operational activities and pending requirements.
Report significant logistical gaps, facility concerns, supply shortages, and operational risks promptly.
Prepare activity updates, asset reports, stock reports, and maintenance reports as required.
Support preparation of monthly operational reports.
Ensure reports are accurate, complete, and submitted on time.
Coordination, Planning & Continuous Improvement
Participate in operational planning and coordination meetings.
Support planning of PHCC administrative and logistical requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve administrative and logistics systems.
Recommend practical solutions to operational challenges.
Follow up on agreed administrative and logistics action points.
Promote efficient use of organizational resources.
Support continuous improvement of PHCC operational systems.
Additional Job Responsibilities
The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive. The role holder may be required to undertake additional duties reasonably related to their qualifications, skills, and experience, based on programme and operational requirements.
Safeguarding
The post holder is required to perform all duties in accordance with the organization's safeguarding, Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), child safeguarding, anti-harassment, code of conduct, and other relevant policies and procedures.

The HR Executive will be responsible for managing daily HR and administrative activities, maintaining employee records, coordinating with employees and management, and ensuring smooth HR operations. The position also requires ERP software management, communication with the ERP software company, and proper maintenance of tender documents.
Human Resources Management
Maintain daily attendance, leave, late entry, and employee records.
Prepare and maintain employee personal files, joining documents, and HR documentation.
Assist in , interview scheduling and onboarding of new employees.
Prepare appointment letters, confirmation letters, promotion letters, and other HR documents.
Maintain employee information and ensure all records are accurate and updated.
ERP Software Management
Develop a clear understanding of the company’s ERP software and its HR & Administration modules.
Manage daily HR activities through ERP software, including attendance, leave applications, site visit entries, and food requests.
Maintain accurate and updated employee information in the ERP system.
Communicate with the ERP software company on a day-to-day basis regarding software issues, updates, and technical support.
Follow up with the ERP software company to resolve technical problems and ensure timely solutions.
Coordinate with employees and department heads to ensure proper adoption and use of ERP software.
Identify software-related problems and report them to management when necessary.
Assist in ERP training, implementation, and improvement of HR processes.
Communication & Typing Skills
Maintain regular communication with employees, department heads, management, and external service providers.
Prepare professional emails, notices, memos, and official letters.
Must be proficient in both
Bangla and English typing
.
Prepare HR documents, reports, and correspondence in Bangla and English as required.
Maintain clear and professional communication with the ERP software company.
Tender Document Management
Maintain and organize all tender-related documents and records.
Prepare, collect, and arrange necessary documents for tender submissions.
Coordinate with relevant departments to collect tender information, certificates, and supporting documents.
Ensure tender documents are properly filed, updated, and easily accessible.
Maintain tender submission records, deadlines, and document checklists.
Assist management in preparing tender-related paperwork and official correspondence.
Administrative Responsibilities
Monitor daily office administrative activities and support smooth office operations.
Maintain office records, registers, and important company documents.
Coordinate with departments regarding office requirements and employee needs.
Assist in maintaining visitor records, office supplies, and administrative reports.
Support company events, meetings, employee activities, and internal programs.
Ensure proper implementation of company rules, policies, and procedures.
Reporting & Additional Duties
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR reports for management.
Maintain HR and administrative data in Excel and other relevant software.
Monitor employee attendance, late entries, and leave balances.
Assist in HR policy development and implementation.
Maintain confidentiality of employee information and company documents.
Perform any other HR, administrative, or documentation-related duties assigned by management.

Title:
Junior Executive – Fountain Operation
Company Name:
Akij Venture Ltd.
Vacancy:
--
Age:

Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary:

Experience:
1 to 5 years
The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Food (Packaged)/Beverage, Group of Companies
Freshers are also encouraged to apply.
Published:
2026-09-18
Application Deadline:
2026-09-30
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Science & Technology, Food Engineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Nutrition, or Other relevant disciplines.
PGD or Certification on Quality Management, QA/QC will be an advantage.
Requirements:
1 to 5 years
The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Food (Packaged)/Beverage, Group of Companies
Freshers are also encouraged to apply.
Skills Required:
Health and Food Safety,Quality Assurance,Quality Control,Quality Inspection
Additional Requirements:
Age 23 to 36 years
Only Male
Candidates with 0–2 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Food Safety, FMCG, Beverage Operations, Food Service or related fields will be an advantage.
Candidates with field-based Fountain Operation, QA/QC or beverage quality experience will receive preference.
Responsibilities & Context:
Visit assigned Fountain Beverage outlets regularly as per the approved Permanent Journey Plan (PJP).
Conduct routine quality and hygiene inspections of Fountain outlets.
Monitor the overall cleanliness and hygiene condition of Fountain machines and surrounding areas.
Ensure proper cleaning and sanitization of Fountain machine components, particularly nozzles, diffusers and other product-contact parts.
Train outlet service personnel on the correct cleaning and sanitization procedures.
Monitor and coordinate Regular Maintenance (RM) activities of Fountain machines.
Ensure Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules are followed for assigned machines.
Monitor potential sources of microbial contamination in Fountain machines and beverage-serving systems.
Use designated beverage testing equipment and instruments to conduct quality checks.
Work closely with the Sales Team across assigned regions to maintain Fountain beverage quality and hygiene.
Job Other Benifits:
Provident fund,Gratuity,Mobile bill,Medical allowance,Insurance
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2

Full Time
Job Work Place:
Work at office

Only Male can apply
